annotations.title: Signet — live price quote (read-only, no trade)

description: A live Jupiter route quote between two assets. QUOTE ONLY — it builds no transaction and cannot move value. Assets resolve two ways and only two: a curated ticker (SOL, USDC) or a FULL mint address. An uncurated ticker is refused rather than guessed, because anyone can mint a token using a familiar symbol. Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.

amount.description: Amount of `from` in BASE units (lamports for SOL). Default: one whole unit.

from.description: Curated ticker or full mint address. Default SOL.

slippage_bps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points, clamped to 1..500. Default 50.

to.description: Curated ticker or full mint address. Default USDC.
